text:
```yaml
name: PR Title Lint

on:
  pull_request_target:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  lint-pr-title:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install --only=dev @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional

      - name: Configure commitlint
        run: echo "module.exports = { extends: ['@commitlint/config-conventional'] };" > commitlint.config.js

      - name: Run commitlint on PR title
        run: npx commitlint --edit .github/workflows/pr-title-lint.yml
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```

This GitHub Actions workflow will check if the PR title follows the conventional commit message format by running `commitlint` when a pull request is opened or updated against the `main` branch. If the title does not follow the expected format, the workflow will fail.
